goal: Build a Python CLI tool to track PR age, review activity, and tech debt across a GitHub organization.
acceptance_criteria: Fetch all repos and PRs for a specified GitHub org using requests and GitHub REST API v3. Handle pagination and rate limits.
Filter PRs stale > 14 days (based on updated_at). Calculate review density = (PR comments + issue comments) / days_open.
Generate a formatted terminal report using rich. Columns: Repo, PR #, Author, Days Open, Review Density, Link. Color-code by age.
